versions.changelog:
- Major cleanup: removed redundant reference and example files for a leaner distribution.
- Added distribution-manifest.json for improved manifest and packaging.
- Updated SKILL.md: version bump to 19.0.0 and metadata refreshed.
- No user-facing changes to core functionality or audit workflow.

Version 18.0.0 — Major content and documentation overhaul

- Completely revised SKILL.md with in-depth descriptions, workflows, and usage boundaries for on-page SEO audits.
- Clarifies audit scope: focuses on structural on-page elements (titles, meta, headers, keywords, links, images) with prioritized scoring and recommendations.
- Differentiates this skill from content-quality (E-E-A-T, publish-readiness) and technical SEO (crawl, indexing, CWV) tools; provides explicit routing guidance.
- Introduces quick prompts for single page, competitor, pre-publish, and bulk audits.
- Defines expected outputs, step-by-step audit process, and tool integration/fallbacks.
- Adds strict instructions on metric labeling (Measured, User-provided, Estimated) and handling of missing or inferred data.
